title_zh: 约定缩小虚构民调结论并核查部门回应

scenario.label_zh: 约定缩小虚构民调结论并核查部门回应
scenario.goal_zh: 区分两城样本与全国结论，并约定另查议会记录中的部门回应

context_zh: 研究课中，两位成人学员审核一份虚构交通政策民调简报。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Clara
sentences.text: Our headline calls this a nationwide poll, but all the responses came from two cities.

sentences.speaker: Jules
sentences.text: You’re right. We can describe what those respondents said, not what the whole country thinks.

sentences.speaker: Clara
sentences.text: The draft also says the transport ministry rejected the proposal. Where did that come from?

sentences.speaker: Jules
sentences.text: I saw a reference to a parliamentary debate, but I haven’t checked what the minister actually said.

sentences.speaker: Clara
sentences.text: Then let’s remove that claim for now. Can you check the debate record while I change the headline?

sentences.speaker: Jules
sentences.text: Yes. I’ll look for the response itself, not just a mention of the debate.
